validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE: confirmed at HIGH tier via the project's own 2019 government approval document (桂发改能源〔2019〕169号, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Development & Reform Commission, dated 2019-02-25/published 2019-03-05), reprinted in full by gas.in-en.com and recovered via a Wayback snapshot after the live gas.in-en.com URL returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches (site is bot-walled, not dead — confirmed via Wayback CDX 'available' check then verified live). This is a primary regulatory source, which alone satisfies the high-tier rubric (docs/reference/confidence_tiers.md). It is independently corroborated by the row's existing GEM-cited ref (archive.org screenshot of www.fusui.gov.cn's own 2024-06-11 '扶绥县发展和改革局 2024年工作计划' page — confirmed via archive.org metadata + a downloaded crop of the actual screenshot, showing the genuine www.fusui.gov.cn masthead), whose archive.org item title itself is literally '扶绥-崇左天然气支线管道' — an independent government body naming the identical project.

CLASSIFICATION: correct — this is a genuine natural-gas transmission branch pipeline (dedicated project, not a gathering/process line); the approval document explicitly discusses pipe route, stations, valve chambers, cathodic protection, and a distinct project-approval code (2018-451400-57-02-036319), consistent with a standalone transmission segment.

DUPLICATE CHECK against the 43-PID roster: NOT a duplicate. The only other Chongzuo-adjacent line in-scope is P4732 'Nanning-Pingxiang gas pipeline' (dia=457mm, cap=0.7 bcm/y, endpoint in Nanning's Jiangnan District) — different diameter, different capacity, different owner (P4732/the wider Nanning-Pingxiang trunk is PipeChina/国家管网集团广西公司-owned per a verified 2025-06-06 Xinhua article on that trunk's Nanning-Chongzuo section commissioning, http://www.gx.xinhuanet.com/20250606/032105f0711e4633a1f26693d3eba852/c.html, length 114.76km/dia 457mm/cap 0.7 bcm/y — those numbers match P4732, not P4725). P4725 is Guangxi Guangtou-owned (a different, provincial/local company) at DN355.6mm and 0.848 bcm/y design — a genuinely distinct physical pipe serving the same city. No merge warranted.

ATTRIBUTION: Owner1 ('Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co Ltd', 100%) and Operator/QCCOwner ('广西广投天然气管网有限公司') both confirmed EXACTLY — the approval document names this company as both the applicant/project legal person ('项目法人') and the party responsible for financing/construction/operation.

SPEC: LengthKnown=83.00km matches the approval's '新建约83公里的天然气管道' exactly (65km in Fusui County + 18km in Jiangzhou District = 83km, internally consistent). Diameter=355.60mm matches 'DN355.6mm' exactly. Capacity=0.85 bcm/y matches the design throughput '8.48亿m3/年' (0.848 bcm/y, rounds to 0.85). SegmentCost=289,750,000 RMB matches the approval's stated total investment '约28974.11万元' (289.7411 million RMB) almost exactly (~0.003% delta, effectively the same figure). Endpoints match precisely: StartLocation 'Fusui County' and EndLocation 'Quzuo Village, Jiangzhou Town, Jiangzhou District' are named VERBATIM in the approval ('起自南宁-扶绥支线,终于位于崇左市江州区江州镇渠座村来安屯北侧...的崇左分输站'). CAVEAT: ConstructionYear=2023 is NOT independently confirmed by anything I found, and is in mild tension with the approval document's own clause (§10) requiring construction to start within 2 years of the Feb-2019 approval, extendable by at most 1 more year (i.e. by ≈early 2022) absent a fresh approval — a 2023 start would be outside that window unless a renewal/re-approval was issued (plausible for a delayed provincial project, but unverified here). Left unresolved rather than disputed.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Could not confirm or rule out that 'construction' is still correct. Two adjacent-but-not-dispositive leads: (1) the row's existing ref, Fusui County's 2024-06-11 annual work plan (archive.org screenshot, current_ref), is reported by other search indexing (not independently re-verifiable by me at full-text depth — the archived screenshot's own visible content, downloaded and read directly, shows only the page masthead + a generic anti-corruption/party-building section, not the pipeline paragraph) to set a target of achieving 'full-line gas commissioning' for the Nanning-Chongzuo natural gas supply by 2024-06-30, explicitly via the 'Fusui-Chongzuo natural gas branch pipeline project' coordination mechanism — i.e. a mid-2024 completion TARGET, not a confirmed completion. (2) A verified 2025-06-06 Xinhua News article (http://www.gx.xinhuanet.com/20250606/032105f0711e4633a1f26693d3eba852/c.html) reports that on 2025-06-03 Chongzuo was connected to the national gas trunk network 'for the first time' via a DIFFERENT, PipeChina-owned pipeline (Nanning-Pingxiang branch, Nanning-Chongzuo section: 114.76km/DN457mm/0.7 bcm/y — matches roster PID P4732's specs, not P4725's) — this confirms Chongzuo's gas supply was still a live, only-partially-solved problem as of mid-2025, but does not itself speak to whether the smaller, separately-owned Guangxi Guangtou Fusui-Chongzuo branch (P4725) had already finished construction independently by then. GEM's own last-update stamp (2025-08-25) postdates both leads without resolving them. Recommend a follow-up: search Guangxi Guangtou / 崇左市发改委 (Chongzuo DRC) announcements directly for '扶绥崇左天然气支线管道工程' + '通气'/'投产' (gas-flow-start / commissioning), and re-source the Status [ref] regardless of the outcome — the current archived screenshot does not verifiably support the 'construction' text (flagged by url_verifier before I started: '200 but data value not found').

summary: P4725 (Fusui-Chongzuo Branch) is a real, correctly-classified, non-duplicate pipeline: its 2019 provincial approval document (recovered via Wayback after the live URL 403'd) confirms length (83km), diameter (355.6mm), capacity (0.85 bcm/y), cost (~289.75M RMB), owner/operator (Guangxi Guangtou), and exact endpoints almost verbatim — 8 fields refs added at high tier. Two caveats left open: ConstructionYear=2023 is unconfirmed and sits outside the approval's own construction-start deadline window; and Status='construction' is UNRESOLVED — the existing ref doesn't verifiably support it, and adjacent (but not dispositive) 2024-06 and 2025-06 leads about Chongzuo's gas-supply situation raise without resolving the question of whether this branch has since gone operating.
